simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּחַק (H1766) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: דָּחַק (dâchaq) means to press , i.e. oppress First listed occurrence: Joel 2 8.

definitions.full: H1766. dachaq [ דָּחַק ] verb thrust, crowd, oppress (Late Hebrew id. , Arabic drive away, remove , Aramaic דְּחַק , ) — Qal Imperfect יִדְחָק֔וּן thrust, crowd , of locusts in swarm Joel 2:8 ; Participle active plural suffix וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם לֹחֲצֵיהֶם Judg 2:18 (because of) them that maltreated and oppressed them.
